lane:
مَعْلَطٌ The _place of the brand called_ عِلَاط _on the neck of the camel:_ (O, K, TA:) and so, accord. to the K, ↓مُعْلَوَّطٌ; but this latter means the _place of the neck of the camel to which one clings_ [_to mount him:_ see 13]. (TA.)

مُعَلَّطٌ A camel _whose cord called_ عِلَاط _has been pulled off from his neck._ (TA.)

entries.text: المعلط، كعملس: الرجل الشديد، قلب عملط، والخبيث الداهية.
